class.name: MaszynaMoverRailVehicleLighting
class.description: [RailVehicleLighting] simulated by the vendored Mover ([code]TMoverParameters[/code]): its configuration is written into the vehicle's Mover and its live values are read straight from it. Created by the FIZ import for a vehicle [MaszynaMoverVehicleServer] simulates; everything else reaches it through [RailVehicleLighting].

members.member: An integer representing the engine type, defined by the RailVehicleEngine.EngineType enumeration
Represents the highest voltage the accumulator can reach when fully charged.
Specifies the maximum voltage of the alternative light source can provide
Specifies the capacity of the alternative light source, typically measured in units like Ampere-hours (Ah). Represents the total amount of energy the alternative light source can store
An integer representing the power source, defined by the VehicleController.TrainPowerSource enumeration
An integer representing the alternative power source, defined by the VehicleController.TrainPowerSource enumeration
An integer representing the power source, defined by the VehicleController.TrainPowerSource enumeration.
